note: Timeline trial: one rule per obligation, each keyed on the dates it actually depends on. Statuses follow the assessment-output schema.

obligations.logic: From 11.9.2026 for every in-scope product, including units placed before 11.12.2027 (Art. 69(3)). Does not depend on the placing date.

Keyed on the placing date of the UNITS assessed, not of the product type. Units placed before 11.12.2027: exempt unless substantially modified from that date. Substantial modification: limb (b) purpose change is decidable; limb (a) effect on Annex I Part I compliance is not decidable by the MVP (LIFE-08).
Existing EU type-examination certificates on cybersecurity under other harmonisation legislation stay valid until 11.6.2028, or earlier expiry, unless that legislation says otherwise.

Radio equipment within the delegated act's limbs, placed on or after 1.8.2025. Still applies after 11.12.2027 as long as it is in force: the Commission has announced an aim to repeal it, which is not a repeal (RED-02). eurlex_watch watches 32022R0030.

resolves.to: Regulation (EU) 2025/2509, via its Art. 56 correlation clause
